VisualNeed/salience routing is a likely donor pattern for WorldNeed sparse JIT materialization, but current source is perception-specific and does not constitute a world-model implementation.

Type-level separation of observation and prior can still be defeated downstream by untyped serialization or later merges; end-to-end non-override must be verified.
A single shared resource owner reduces camera contention but may create a bottleneck or failure domain; ownership and backpressure need explicit measurement.
